Scope wipe implemented as scroll-triggered clip reveal but remains single moment rather than full photographic narrative.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Voice matches concept. Concrete trade nouns (flue, smoke shelf, baffle, chase cover). Sample labels on all reviews/prices/rating. Primary action consistently Book a visit. No banned phrases. Microcopy at form, phone, ZIP check.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg and 390-full.jpg: h1 3 lines, CTAs above fold, tap targets ≥48px, mobile bar works. render.json: 390px scrollWidth=390, no wide elements, overflow resolved. 390-rm-full.jpg: all content visible.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg: all content visible under reduced motion. Focus 3px watch outline. Skip link. Fieldset/legend labels. Heading order h1→h2→h3. Forced colors handled.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg through 1440-scroll-50.jpg: Camera-scope wipe implemented as pinned circular clip-path on flue photo in sweep finding section. Reveal translateY+opacity, stagger on chips, clip on images. Reduced motion shows everything. Hooks: data-reveal, data-count, data-zip, data-open-now, ScrollTrigger pin for scope wipe.

wow.notes: 1440-first.jpg and 1440-scroll-25.jpg: Finding-note signature is the wow — visit note as page with numbered findings and status chips. Camera-scope wipe connects static hero signature to animated scroll moment, creating two connected moments tied to thesis and trade. Tools designed in finding language.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon, apple-touch-icon, OG 1200x630, theme-color, JSON-LD HomeAndConstructionBusiness, print stylesheet, lazy images with dimensions, consistent radius and rule weight, designed footer.

elevate.move: Art-direct the photo sequence so crops tell a plan→work→result story across the services and process sections, using the scope clip as a recurring frame treatment that ties every image to the finding-note signature rather than applying it only to the hero.

Make the scope wipe output a printable finding sheet that the homeowner can save or share, so the tool's output is designed in the signature's language and the wow becomes something they keep, not just something they watch.
